summary: HIDOE supports keeping E‑Rate, opposes narrowing its scope or adding new conditions, and backs state‑level safe‑technology policies. HIDOE urges the FCC to preserve E‑Rate funding, oppose cuts to special construction and dark fiber, and reject screen‑time limits and personal‑device filtering. HIDOE urges the FCC to keep E‑Rate funding and to adopt measures that strengthen program integrity, simplify administration, and preserve flexibility for state and local educational leaders.
